svg.aria-label: PayBox approval gate: an agent's purchase request rides a rail as an order slip in a robot cart's basket and slides into a PayBox vault press. The stamped order ticket only drops down the chute into the output tray after the buyer pulls the lit-orange approval lever (passkey). The dial on the vault top is the approval mode, Always Ask versus Autonomous; the gauge caps how much a purchase may cost; the drum holds the wallet key split into three parts, so no single party holds the whole key. Verified numbers: about 300,000 Whop businesses, $7B+ processed across 185 countries.
svg.text: 300,000 Whop stores · buyer approves every payment · $0 moves without approval
